description: A four-channel ratcheting sequencer whose playheads move across a shared hexagonal grid, raising a trigger and a voltage on each filled cell they enter.

inputs.text: A trigger moves the yellow playhead one cell along its current direction.
A trigger moves that playhead one cell along its current direction; with nothing patched it follows the yellow channel's clock, unless normalling is switched off on the menu.
A trigger returns the yellow playhead to its start cell, which is set by dragging it while the grid is in edit mode.
A trigger returns that playhead to its start cell; with nothing patched it follows the yellow channel's reset, unless normalling is switched off on the menu.
A trigger turns the yellow playhead by 60 degrees, 120 degrees, alternating 60 and 120, or 180 degrees, as its context menu is set.
A trigger turns that playhead by the angle picked on its context menu; with nothing patched it follows the yellow channel's turn input, unless normalling is switched off.
A trigger shifts every playhead one lane to the right and upwards, relative to the direction each is travelling.
A trigger shifts every playhead one lane to the right and downwards, relative to the direction each is travelling.
A trigger shifts every playhead one lane to the left and upwards, relative to the direction each is travelling.
A trigger shifts every playhead one lane to the left and downwards, relative to the direction each is travelling.

outputs.text: Fires a trigger each time that playhead enters a filled cell, or a burst of ratchets on a half-filled one.
Carries the voltage stored in the cell that playhead last triggered on, within the range set for that channel, 0-3V by default.

notes: clicking a cell steps it through off, filled and half-filled, and gives it a new random voltage each time.
a playhead produces nothing until cells are filled: click a cell on the grid, or use Randomize on the grid's own right-click menu.
menu: Dimension — sizes the grid by its radius in cells; Randomize, Randomize certainty and Clear fill or empty its cells.
Enter Edit-mode — on the grid's own right-click menu, which then lets each playhead's start cell be dragged while the sequencer keeps running; Exit Edit-mode leaves it.
Ratcheting — on a playhead's own right-click menu in edit mode: Off, Default, Twos, Threes or Power of 2, with Ratcheting probability from 30% to 90% favouring longer bursts.
Start direction — on a playhead's own right-click menu in edit mode: NE, E, SE, SW, W or NW.
Turn mode — on a playhead's own right-click menu in edit mode: Sixty, Ninety, One-Twenty or One-Eighty.
CV mode — on a playhead's own right-click menu in edit mode: -5..5V, 0..5V, 0..3V or 0..1V, the range that channel's CV output covers.
Normalize inputs to Yellow — switched off, each channel's clock, reset and turn ports stop following the yellow channel when nothing is patched to them.
